decisions.decision: Use cryptographically secure 32-byte hex token, SHA-256 hashed in database, with 15-minute expiration and single-use invalidation. Enforce generic response on reset request to prevent user enumeration.
decisions.rationale: Follows OWASP authentication and credential reset recommendations and .ai/skills/security/SKILL.md specifications.
alternatives: Plain text token (rejected: severe vulnerability if DB compromised)
Long expiration time > 1hr (rejected: exceeds security window)
Reveal non-existent user email (rejected: enables account enumeration)

decisions.decision: Streamlined project-init to direct build-first scaffolding and inside-out UI development; updated dna-stamper.js to copy full 155-line coding-rules.md and 195-line ui-guidelines.md instead of 30-line templates; pruned meta-skill prompt adapters from .agents/skills to eliminate context distraction; streamlined AGENTS.md primary workflows.
decisions.rationale: Audit revealed that new projects generated inferior UI due to template dilution (30-line stubs replacing full rules) and mandatory competitor research interrupting build momentum. This restores peak Sep 17 build velocity while retaining self-sufficient project DNA.
alternatives: Revert completely to Sep 17 (rejected: loses multi-project portable DNA benefits)
Keep 5D research mandatory (rejected: slows builds and degrades output quality)
